title: Honey Soy Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets brushed with a sticky honey, soy and ginger glaze and roasted until just flaky. Ready in about twenty minutes.
equipment: Rimmed baking sheet lined with foil

image.alt: Glazed salmon fillets with sesame and green onion, beside rice

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Pat the salmon dry, season lightly with the salt and lay it skin side down on the baking sheet.
Simmer the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger and garlic in the saucepan for {time 2 min}. Stir the cornstarch with {qty 1 tbsp} water, whisk it in and simmer until glossy and thick, {time 1 min}.
Brush half the glaze over the salmon and roast until it flakes easily in the thickest part, {time 10-12 min}.
Brush with the rest of the glaze and broil for {time 1-2 min} to caramelize, watching closely. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions.

notes: USDA recommends 145°F for fish. Many cooks pull salmon at 125 to 130°F for a moist, medium center.
